title: Bipartite spanning subgraph preserving half of every degree
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V$. Then $G$ has a spanning subgraph $H$ that is bipartite (that is, $2$-colourable) and in which every vertex keeps at least half of its original degree: writing $d_G(v)$ for the degree of $v$ in $G$ and $d_H(v)$ for the number of neighbours of $v$ in $H$, one has $d_G(v) \le 2\,d_H(v)$ for every $v \in V$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph on vertex set V
